Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
AI-powered disinformation spreads rapidly ahead of US elections, evolving in Spanish and amplified by government claims. Confirmed by The Guardian.
Silicon Valley artificial intelligence development and safety groups battle in elections, spending millions to influence congressional races. Confirmed by CNBC.
Akamai launches artificial intelligence inference and agent sandbox tools for enterprises on its cloud platform. Confirmed by Markets Insider.
Anthropic files for IPO valued at $1.5T–$2T, citing 1,300% revenue growth and artificial intelligence safety concerns. Confirmed by WBHM 90.3.
Apple's iOS 27.2 adds Siri artificial intelligence with multilingual support and memory, rolling out to new iPhone models. Confirmed by The Next Web.
